sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Agency for Equities, CFDs and Derivative Instruments

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law with customary law elements; unitary national legislation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) – trade in goods and services
EU-Pacific States Interim Economic Partnership Agreement – trade and investment facilitation
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force with the United States, United Kingdom, or Australia

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 (Samoa), as amended; International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, including the International Companies Amendment Acts 2015 abolishing bearer shares and mandating registered share and beneficial ownership records; Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) licensing and AML directives; Central Bank of Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) guidelines; United Nations sanctions implementation regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Samoan registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Samoa has been a Contracting Party since 25 March 2019)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each shareholder's passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or gazetted commissioner of oaths in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or notarized bank reference letter from the introducing bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution maintaining the shareholder's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of constitutional documents, certificate of incorporation and certificate of incumbency of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction company registry or licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference and source-of-wealth declaration for each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified public accountant, attorney, or licensed financial adviser in the country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD and EDD for PEPs, OFAC, UN and Samoan domestic sanctions list screening administered by the Samoan Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade; screening required at onboarding, on a continuous risk-triggered basis, and prior to each transaction; high-risk jurisdictions subject to enhanced due diligence; suspicious transaction reports must be filed with the Samoa FIU without tipping-off; statutory records retained for at least 5 years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – International Companies Section; filings effected exclusively through licensed Samoan registered agents; no unrestricted public e-filing portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English using the Latin alphabet; non-Latin names (e.g., Chinese) must be transliterated into Latin script for the registered English name, though a parallel Chinese-language alias may be adopted by resolution and recorded at the registered agent's office; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing domestic or international company in Samoa.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the registered agent may file a written objection with the Registrar within 14 days; if refused, an administrative review may be sought from the Minister responsible for companies within 21 days; judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa remains available. Extension of name reservation may be applied for no earlier than 30 days before expiry and is subject to an additional government fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a substitute for the statutory physical registered office and licensed registered agent requirement under the International Companies Act 1987; a serviced physical address in Samoa may be used, but the registered agent must maintain accessible premises and records capable of inspection by the Registrar and SIFA.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate to High for licensed securities brokerage: baseline annual inspection risk approximately 30%, increasing to approximately 45% during the first 18 months of SIFA authorization; unannounced inspections of registered agent records and UBO files are possible.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government fee – name clearance and reservation
Government fee – International Company incorporation filing
Registered agent and registered office annual retainer
Notarization and Hague Apostille of Power of Attorney and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent apostille authority in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per document set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register establishment and ongoing maintenance
AML/CFT policy pack, PEP and sanctions screening setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent AML consultant or registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for high-risk securities brokerage

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SIFA pre-licensing advisory and scope assessment (ISIC 6611 – High Risk Special License)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for high-risk special license advisory

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and translation of certified documents
Certified English translations of any Chinese-language corporate documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss. 5, 9, 11 and 13 (incorporation, constitution, registered office and certificate of incorporation); read with the Financial Services Authority Act 2011 for offshore regulatory oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; issued capital may be as low as one share. No escrow or paid-up deposit is required under the International Companies Act 1987; only a registered office and licensed registered agent must be maintained in Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED that the initial share subscription be and is hereby accepted, and the directors allot the subscribers' shares in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association; BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of its licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and that such agent be appointed to receive service of process; BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name of Director], [Name of Secretary], and [Name of Principal Officer] be appointed to their respective offices, with authority to open bank accounts, execute the offshore securities brokerage license application, and settle all statutory incorporation filings; BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that all actions already taken in connection herewith are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia — submission via licensed registered agent portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search against the register of international companies and reserved names. Submit Form IC-N1 requesting reservation of the proposed company name together with proof of subscriber identity. Ensure the name includes or omits 'Limited' or 'International Company' suffix as intended and is not confusingly similar to an existing entity.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport or other government-issued identity document of each subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or is similar to a prior reservation, file an alternative name application or submit a written appeal to the Registrar within 14 days of refusal; the appeal is determined within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Apia and authorized Notary Public (admitted in Samoa).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English (a Chinese-English bilingual version may be adopted if approved by the agent). Ensure the M&A contains permitted objects for offshore securities brokerage, share structure, director and secretary provisions, and the registered agent clause. Have each subscriber execute the instrument before a notary public, and obtain the registered agent's written consent to act.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed and notarized)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where notarial certificates are defective or signatures are incomplete, the instrument is returned for re-execution and fresh notarization within 5 business days at no additional registry fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA — online filing portal or physical counters at the SIFA head office, Apia.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 together with the executed M&A, registered agent consent, and declarations of directors and secretary. Attach the name reservation certificate and pay the prescribed incorporation fee by wire or at the SIFA cashier. The Registrar examines the documents for statutory completeness under ss. 5–13 of the Act.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consents of directors, secretary and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a requisition letter issues, respond with amended documents within 30 days; failure to respond results in deemed withdrawal, and a fresh application may be filed with a new fee or the original fee credited at the Registrar's discretion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Filing Fees and Stamp Duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA Finance Office and Samoa Ministry for Revenue (stamp duty assessment).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Settle the USD 200 incorporation filing fee and applicable stamp duty upon issuance of the fee invoice. Obtain an official receipt referencing the company name and Form IC-1 submission number. Retain the receipt for issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Wire remittance advice or paid receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Incorrect payment references are cured by filing a payment reconciliation affidavit with the SIFA Finance Office within 3 business days; no penalty applies if the correct amount was remitted within the filing window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory completion of examination and payment, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under ss. 13 of the International Companies Act 1987. Verify the legal name, incorporation date, registered office and company number printed on the certificate. Order three certified true copies and, where required, a 'Certificate of Good Standing' for the subsequent license application.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains clerical errors, file Form IC-7 for rectification; reprint is completed within 3 business days. Lost certificates are replaced upon statutory declaration and publication fee payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Steps and Registered Office Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent, Apia, and the newly formed board of directors.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass the written resolution adopting share allotment, appointment of directors, secretary and principal officer, and the establishment of the registered office. Issue share certificates and open a segregated client money account at a licensed bank in Samoa. File the notice of directors and officers with the Registrar if required.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening application with client money segregation undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the bank or agent queries the resolution, the board may ratify by a confirmatory resolution; any shareholder challenge is settled through a special resolution passed within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Financial Services Authority (FSA), Apia — Capital Markets and Offshore Licensing Division.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Offshore Securities Brokerage Licence (Retail) — High-Risk Special License under the Financial Services Authority Act 2011 and market conduct rules applicable to ISIC 6611 activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Environment Regulatory Division, Samoa.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-Impact Financial Services Activity — Schedule 3 Registration; Full EIA Report not required for a non-manufacturing, paper-based brokerage undertaking with no physical processing plant.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to industrial process discharges; office premises must comply with World Bank Group General EHS Guidelines (wastewater BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L) and Samoa ambient air quality standards for PM10/PM2.5; electronic waste handling must follow Basel Convention transboundary rules via licensed recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); structural load inspection clearance from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI); and workplace occupational health clearance for office premises issued under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Independent State of Samoa; official e-services portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company (IC) is formed under the International Companies Act 1987 through a licensed registered agent with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA). The tax identification procedure consists of filing with SRA the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office certificate, and a statutory declaration of exclusive offshore business, accompanied by the prescribed Tax Exemption Certificate application. SRA issues the IC's Tax Exemption Certificate and, if requested for banking or FATCA/CRS purposes, a non-resident TIN. The procedure does not create a VAGST registration; VAGST registration is opened only when the IC commences a taxable Samoan activity or elects voluntary registration for export zero-rating.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: the IC is statutorily exempt from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and estate duty on its worldwide offshore business. It is not a pass-through entity and is not subject to ordinary Samoan entity-level tax; the exemption is preserved by the annual declaration and payment of the International Company registration fee to SIFA.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available in Samoa. An IC may elect to convert into a domestic company under the Companies Act 2001, thereby becoming a Samoa tax resident and losing the International Companies Act tax exemption; the election must be notified to both SIFA and SRA. Hybrid mismatch elections do not exist in Samoa, but the IC may obtain a binding tax ruling from SRA confirming the VAGST export zero-rating treatment of principal brokerage, agency brokerage, and introducing-broker fee structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) administered by the Samoa Revenue Authority under the VAGST Act 2007
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 50,000 (Samoan Tala/SAT) of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; an offshore International Company supplying securities brokerage services exclusively to non-residents does not meet this nexus and is not registrable unless it voluntarily registers for zero-rated export supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently impose mandatory real-time e-invoicing, digital stamping, or API transaction-clearance for tax purposes. Registered VAGST suppliers must issue a tax invoice carrying the supplier's VAGST registration number, customer details, date, description, consideration, and VAGST amount. SRA's portal provides electronic filing and payment only; there is no pre-clearance approval loop for brokerage invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAGST Act 2007, supplies of goods or services are zero-rated when they are exported or supplied to a person outside Samoa and the benefits of the supply are wholly enjoyed outside Samoa. Offshore securities brokerage services—order execution, custody, settlement, and CFDs/derivatives dealing—are supplied and consumed outside Samoa and therefore fall outside the Samoa VAGST net; if the IC is voluntarily registered, these offshore commissions and fees are zero-rated. The IC must demonstrate that the client is non-resident, the onboarding did not occur through any Samoa branch, and no brokerage service was performed for a Samoa-resident person.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs prescribed form) — required for physical exports; for brokerage, the functional equivalent is the client's electronic order ticket and broker execution record.
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill — required for physical exports; not applicable to offshore securities services.
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit confirmation evidencing receipt of cleared brokerage proceeds from the non-resident client.
Executed client agreement, KYC file, and monthly brokerage statements evidencing the offshore place of supply and non-resident beneficiary.
SRA Tax Exemption Certificate and, if voluntary VAGST registration was obtained, the VAGST registration certificate supporting the zero-rating position.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA can audit zero-rating and exemption claims for up to the statutory reassessment period, with an extended period in cases of fraudulent or negligent conduct. A false zero-rating or fabricated export claim triggers immediate refund clawback, assessment of VAGST at 15%, statutory interest, civil shortfall penalties (which may reach 150% of the tax evaded for fraudulent conduct), and criminal prosecution of the IC and its officers. SIFA may also retrospectively revoke the IC's tax-exempt status if it is found that the brokerage was not genuinely offshore, causing all historical income to be taxed with penalties from the date of incorporation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa operates a surveillance-based exchange control regime under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1984. The Samoan tālā (WST) is not fully convertible; current account transactions are generally permitted through authorised dealers, whereas capital account transactions require prior CBS approval. Non-resident International Companies enjoy exemptions in respect of external accounts and foreign currency holdings, but profit remittance to shareholders triggers documentary review for tax clearance and CBS notification. Brokerage client funds and operational disbursements must be routed through authorised banks to avoid unauthorised capital transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must repatriate export proceeds within 180 days of shipment and offer 100% of foreign currency earnings for conversion to WST within 7 days of receipt. Non-resident International Companies are not subject to compulsory surrender provided receipts are credited to an approved External Account; if any Samoa-origin export proceeds are credited to a domestic account, 100% must be surrendered within 7 days. For brokerage services, service export fees from overseas clients are treated as current receipts and may be retained in the IC's external account.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa has no dedicated EMI licensing framework, and non-resident digital banks are not supervised by CBS for domestic account opening. Offshore EMIs are generally unsuitable as principal clearing accounts for a Samoa International Company engaged in retail securities brokerage because of higher AML/CFT scrutiny and the sectoral requirement to hold client money through a regulated bank under CBS supervision.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not an absolute statutory mandate, but tier-1 domestic banks generally require at least one director or the designated compliance officer to attend an in-person or video-notarised interview for high-risk brokerage accounts. Remote opening may be permitted for non-face-to-face customers with certified corporate documents and enhanced due diligence; however, most tier-1 banks impose a mandatory physical interview for beneficial owners of a high-risk special license.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer shares or unverified beneficial ownership structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, register of directors and shareholders, beneficial ownership register, government-issued IDs for all shareholders and directors, and sworn source-of-funds declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore securities brokerage license issued in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the International Brokerage Licence issued by the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA), the International Company's registration documents, and evidence of regulated status in any foreign home jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payments or opaque funding sources
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements covering the relevant period, client source-of-wealth questionnaires, supporting trade contracts or account application forms, and a sworn declaration of beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO jurisdiction on an OFAC/EU/global tax blacklist
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Risk-rating memo, sanctions screening results, negative media search, independent legal opinion from qualified counsel, and confirmation of tax-transparency filing compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from an account in the same beneficial owner's name; the payment purpose code must state 'equity injection' for capital contributions and 'client funds' for brokerage money. Supporting board resolutions, client agreements, and source-of-funds documentation must be lodged with the receiving bank. WST conversions require booking with an authorised dealer and CBS reporting where the transaction exceeds regulatory thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Securities settlement and client withdrawals must be executed through SWIFT MT103 for client disbursements, MT202 for interbank treasury transfers, and Commercial Letters of Credit where the brokerage acts as principal in trade-related settlements. Settlement instructions must be pre-verified by the clearing bank; high-value transactions require dual authorisation and CBS approval where applicable under the Exchange Control Regulations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward (up to 12 months) with an authorised dealer
Non-deliverable WST/USD forward for hedging economic exposure
Cross-currency swap between WST and USD for match funding
Vanilla FX option contracts subject to CBS notification

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; a late return may be accepted within 30 days thereafter subject to a late filing fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fee of 10% per month for up to 60 days; continued non-compliance results in a Registrar's warning and administrative strike-off after 12 months, with directors becoming jointly and severally liable for outstanding fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Ownership Change Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit / SIFA AML/CFT Compliance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation and within 14 days of any shareholding or ultimate beneficial ownership transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to WST 50,000 and, for willful omission, criminal penalties including imprisonment of officers; persistent violation may lead to licence revocation for regulated securities entities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Offshore Securities Brokerage Licence Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SIFA – Financial Services Licensing Desk (oversight of ISIC 6611 securities brokerage)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the licence expiry date (calendar-year aligned, typically 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic suspension of brokerage and client order execution upon lapse; continued non-payment leads to revocation of the securities licence, disqualification of the licensee, and a public notice of non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all licensed securities brokerages under ISIC 6611 regardless of revenue level; an unlicensed International Company is exempt only if gross annual revenue does not exceed WST 500,000 and total assets remain below WST 2,000,000, subject to annual shareholder approval
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Samoa for licensed financial entities; an unlicensed International Company may apply the IFRS for SMEs framework if satisfying exemption thresholds

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain a register of beneficial owners at its registered office and file an annual confirmation statement with the Registrar. Any share transfer must be approved by the board, recorded in the Register of Members, and reflected in the beneficial ownership confirmation submitted within 14 days of the transfer. For licensed securities brokerages, client fund segregation and nominee shareholding arrangements must also be disclosed to SIFA in the annual confirmation.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective on all foreign-source and exempt income of an International Company (IC); 27% statutory corporate income tax rate under the Income Tax Act 2013-2018 applies only to Samoa-source income or deemed domestic-source income of an IC that breaches its offshore conditions
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from CIT, dividend income, interest and royalties from offshore investments for ICs; no capital gains tax on disposals of foreign securities; VAT/GST (VAGST) zero-rated on cross-border brokerage service fees charged to non-resident clients; no deemed profit attribution to Samoa absent domestic-source brokerage activity

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IRD-94 — Corporate Income Tax Return (annual assessment form) via the Samoa Revenue Corporation (SRC) eFiling portal; required only if an IC has assessable Samoa-source income; nil filings are not required for a qualifying exempt IC whose sole economic presence is registered-agent and compliance substance
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Six months after the fiscal year-end; for a standard 31 December year-end the filing and payment deadline is 30 June of the following calendar year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross taxable income from all Samoa-source and foreign-source business activity conducted through a Samoa permanent establishment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt IC: enter 0 unless unauthorized domestic-source trading occurred; otherwise enter gross commissions, spreads and CFD/equities-related revenue

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses wholly and exclusively incurred in gaining assessable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter arm's-length operating costs, clearing fees and agent fees; claim offset only against non-exempt income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net amount after deductions; losses carried forward up to 5 years
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt IC: enter 0; otherwise calculate net income and apply carryforward losses in chronological order

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory income tax computed on Box 3
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt IC: enter 0; domestic-source violator computes at 27% with no discretionary offset

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax liability after credits, withholding and quarterly installments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt IC: enter 0; any positive amount must be paid by 30 June

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax assessed per month or part (capped at 50%), a fixed automatic penalty of WST 1,000 for non-filing, late payment penalty of 5% per month plus monthly interest at 2%, and director-level criminal sanctions for willful non-compliance

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ESR-1 — Annual Economic Substance Return for International Companies, filed by the IC's licensed registered agent through the Samoa International Companies Registry / Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour digital portal; mandatory even for exempt ICs
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the accounting period; a 31 December period must be reported by 31 December of the following year; registered agent must sign and authenticate

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A — Company identification and tax reference number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC name, registry number, TIN, jurisdiction of incorporation, date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the IC is not tax resident in Samoa and holds no domestic trading license

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select the economic substance relevant activity from the prescribed list
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Securities brokerage/ISIC 6611 must select finance and investment intermediary or equivalent relevant activity; exact classification must mirror the specific ESR list

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income, net assessable income, income by source
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt IC: report all non-Samoan income, declare no domestic activity; include breakdown of brokerage fees, CFD settlement income and interest from segregated client funds

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full-time employees, qualifications, physical premises, annual operating expenditure, banking arrangements, core income generating activity locations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State truthful headcount, office lease and IT infrastructure figures; for a pure offshore IC, evidence of direction and management performed partly in Samoa is required to preserve exempt status

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section E — Outsourcing and group arrangements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of functions delegated to third parties or affiliates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose any outsourced trading desk, KYC, and IT functions; confirm Samoa-based oversight and availability of records to regulators

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to submit ESR-1: initial penalty WST 20,000 plus continuing daily penalty of WST 1,000; filing a knowingly false return: WST 100,000 penalty and/or imprisonment up to 7 years; the IC may be struck off and the tax-exempt certificate revoked

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends distributed by a qualifying exempt International Company to non-resident shareholders where the profits are foreign-source and the distribution is made after the IC exemption certificate is in force; 15% domestic non-resident dividend withholding tax under the Income Tax Act applies where the IC is deemed to have Samoa-source profits or trades with residents
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Samoa double tax agreement (Australia, New Zealand, Norway, China) the payer must (i) obtain the shareholder's tax residency certificate via the beneficiary's competent authority, endorsed by the Samoa Revenue Corporation; (ii) file the IRD WHT-TR withholding tax relief application not later than 30 days before distribution; and (iii) certify the treaty ownership and 5% substantial-shareholding conditions are fulfilled. Reduced rates: substantial shareholding 5% for persons holding 10% or more of the voting capital for 12 months, otherwise 15%; interest 10%; royalties 10%; mutual agreement and exchange of information provisions apply
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates: 15% non-resident withholding tax on interest and royalty payments made by a Samoa resident payer; treaty rates: 10% under standard Samoa DTA provisions; exempt International Companies acting as payers on foreign-source flows are not required to withhold, provided the underlying obligation is not economically connected to a Samoa permanent establishment

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 annual aggregate cross-border related-party transactions (approximately USD 370,000 under official WST/USD 2.60 band) triggers the obligation to prepare and maintain arm's-length benchmark documentation, a local substance file and board-approved transfer pricing policy
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's International Companies (Economic Substance) Rules 2021-2023 impose a full economic substance test on ICs carrying relevant activities, expressly including securities brokerage, trading, and financial intermediation. The IC must meet all of: (a) physical staff in Samoa appropriate to the brokerage volume; (b) premises and managerial presence proportionate to core income-generating activities; (c) minimum operating expenditure in Samoa; (d) no reliance on shell activities or nominee managers. Outsourcing may shift CIGAs outside Samoa but cannot defeat the substance standard unless controlled and disclosed. Failure of the economic substance test does not merely trigger a penalty; it exposes the IC to taxation on its entire global income at 27%, revocation of the IC certificate, and re-characterization of the entity as a shell for AML purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion through false exemption declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An IC holds itself out as tax-exempt while its broker-dealer operations direct orders, execute settlement instructions, accept client money, or solicit Samoan residents for equities, CFDs and derivative instruments without recording Samoa-source revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Deemed domestic-source income taxed at 27% with a late payment surcharge of 5% per month and penal interest of 2% per month; evasion penalty equal to 100% of the omitted tax; filing of backdated returns for up to 6 years; international company certificate revoked and entity struck off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed registered agent are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; the court may issue a travel ban, restraint orders over personal and family assets, and imprisonment of directors for up to 7 years on indictable tax evasion

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC has no employees, no lease or premises in Samoa, CIGA decisions executed exclusively from Taiwan/China/Hong Kong offices, and no accounting records physically available in Samoa; the registered agent merely holds the compliance plaque and writes nil ESR returns
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic ESR failure: penalty WST 20,000 plus WST 1,000 daily continuous default and WST 100,000 for false statements; the IC loses its tax exemption, is liable to 27% CIT on worldwide profits, and may be struck from the International Companies Register with restoration only after regulatory scrutiny
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors serve a disqualification order of up to 5 years across all Samoa companies; the liquidation costs and obligations fall on the directors' personal estates; officers are personally liable for penalty claims where the IC was operated as a facade

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed financial services and AML breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating retail securities brokerage, CFD trading or payment acceptance via Visa/Mastercard and segregated client wires in or into Samoa without a statutory license, AML/CFT registration, or suspicious transaction reporting; combining client money with operating accounts or using unnamed nominee structures
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlicensed financial business fine up to WST 500,000; money laundering forfeiture of all client and corporate assets held on account; per-count criminal fine up to WST 200,000; license ineligibility and permanent registry strike-off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face imprisonment of 5 to 10 years, confiscation of brokerage profits, restitution orders for defrauded retail clients, and extradition exposure where counterpart financial regulators issue mutual legal assistance requests

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer pricing and related-party profit diversion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC under-prices clearing, payment processing and customer-introduction services to a connected entity in zero-tax jurisdictions, records nil-margin intercompany swaps, and deposits the economic profit with a sister entity while the IC bears all operational risk and compliance costs
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Samoa Revenue Corporation substitutes an arm's-length price and increases taxable income; penalty of up to 75% of the transfer pricing adjustment, plus interest from the original due date; the practice is treated as an act of evasion if documentation is fabricated
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved or signed the related-party arrangements are liable for the aggregate unpaid penalty where the IC is insolvent; senior officers may be charged with filing false statements; court may appoint a receiver over the sister entity for recovery

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Beneficial ownership concealment and false registry filings
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC uses bearer instruments, exercises powers of attorney through nominee shareholders, conceals Chinese or US tax-resident controllers that actually manage the brokerage, or the registered agent files an ESR saying income is passive while the entity trades active retail derivatives
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML regime sanctions in addition to tax penalties: fines up to WST 300,000 for failure to maintain a beneficial ownership register; automatic disclosure of the concealed controller to the Samoa Revenue Corporation and exchange of information under CRS/AEOI; IC certificate voided from inception
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and registered agents face WST 100,000 personal fines and imprisonment up to 3 years; the concealment is treated as fraudulent insolvency and supports cross-border money-laundering extradition; directors are personally ordered to repatriate illicit client funds
